During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this '''trooper served''' as a Battalion Commander. He was led by a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] and fought in several battles such as the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]], the [[Skirmish on Carlac]], and the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Battalion Commander serves as the Trooper Class alternative to the player's character on ''Clone Wars Adventures''.
